name: manage_harness
description: Create or structurally evolve a visual, runnable Harness through the compact Harness Blueprint protocol. For edits: inspect first, then patch with the returned revision. Prefer small patch operations over replacing raw pipeline JSON. Use guide when unsure.

action.description: guide=get the compact format; contract=get the small port/event contract for one node type; inspect=read a Harness and revision; validate=compile without writing; create=create a new Harness; patch=apply structural operations atomically; rollback=undo one patch transaction

harness_name.description: Existing Harness directory name for inspect/patch, or optional name override for validate

blueprint.description: For validate/create: {name, description, roles, start, steps}. Each step is {id,type,role?,next?|on?|routes?|config?}. Use action=guide for the full compact vocabulary.

operations.description: For patch: a short list using add_step, update_step, replace_step, remove_step, connect, disconnect, set_start, set_role, remove_role, set_prompt, remove_prompt or set_fields

expected_revision.description: Revision returned by inspect. Required by convention for safe model edits.

dry_run.description: Validate and return the diff without writing

node_type.description: For contract: canonical node type such as Agent, 模型, 上下文 or 子流程
